name: Ghost Trail
description: Creates a beautiful trail of fading ghost sprites behind the player as they move through levels. Fully customizable spawn rate, opacity, and color settings.

spawn-rate.name: Spawn Rate
spawn-rate.description: Number of ghost sprites spawned per second. Higher values create a smoother trail but may impact performance on older devices.

opacity.name: Ghost Opacity
opacity.description: Initial opacity of ghost sprites (0-255). Lower values create more subtle ghosts.

use-player-color.name: Use Player Color
use-player-color.description: When enabled, ghost sprites will inherit the player's icon color. When disabled, ghosts will be white.
